subject: english
title: Poskusni test: People are people (Unit 1)
intro: Kot pravi test: 30 minut, brez namigov. Reši vse, kar znaš, potem se vrni k težjim nalogam. Rešitve vidiš na koncu.
source: Written by Claude from the Unit 1 topic (Wider World 1), in the usual test layout: vocabulary, grammar, translation, writing, listening.

traps.why: Spain je država; iščemo narodnost: Spanish.

tasks.prompt: You wear them on your feet when you play football.
Dopolni s pravo obliko (have got): My sister ______ a new phone.
tasks.solution: My sister = she, zato has got: My sister has got a new phone.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z zanikano obliko (have got): We ______ a cat.
tasks.solution: We → have got, zanikano: haven't got. We haven't got a cat.

tasks.prompt: Sestavi vprašanje: your brother / a bike / has / got / ?
tasks.answer: Has your brother got a bike?
tasks.solution: Vprašanje začne Has, nato oseba, nato got: Has your brother got a bike?

tasks.prompt: Ana is my friend. ___ dad is a teacher.
tasks.solution: Anin oče = njen oče: Her dad.
On je iz Kopra = He is from Koper = He's from Koper.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni kratek odgovor. »Can your dad cook?« »Yes, ______.«
Prevedi v angleščino: Moja babica je Italijanka.
tasks.solution: My grandmother is Italian. (Narodnost z veliko: Italian.)

tasks.prompt: Prevedi: Moj brat ne zna plavati.
tasks.solution: ne zna = can't: My brother can't swim.

tasks.prompt: Prevedi: Ali ima tvoja sestra modre oči?
tasks.answer: Has your sister got blue eyes?
tasks.solution: Has your sister got blue eyes?

tasks.prompt: V zvezek napiši 5 povedi o članu svoje družine: kdo je, od kod je, kako izgleda, kaj ima in kaj zna.
tasks.solution: Primer: My uncle is Marko. He's Slovenian. He's tall and he has got short brown hair. He has got a red car. He can play the guitar but he can't swim. (Za 5 točk: 5 pravilnih povedi; has got pri he/she, narodnost z veliko.)

tasks.say: My uncle is Scottish and he has got red hair.
tasks.answer: My uncle is Scottish and he has got red hair.
accept: My uncle is Scottish and he's got red hair.
tasks.solution: My uncle is Scottish and he has got red hair.
